compiled_state.title: As an engineer, the multi-turn loop honors a soft-cap nudge cascade with explicit numerics and a post-nudge state machine
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: ## Description **What**: Extend the single-turn round-trip from S1 to a multi-turn loop with per-tier configurable soft cap (default 15 turns), wrap-up nudge at soft_cap, second harder nudge at soft_cap+3, fail-closed via record-review.sh on continued non-compliance. Add explicit post-nudge state-machine rule for assistant turns containing both well-formed request and final-findings. **Why**: SC4. Without the cascade, a misbehaving reviewer can loop indefinitely and burn budget or hang the CI gate. **Scope**: - IN: per-tier soft cap config (default 15); second cap at soft_cap+3; first nudge wrap-up message; second harder nudge; fail-closed via record-review.sh; post-nudge rule (request ignored AND counts as strike toward second nudge when both blocks present) - OUT: applying the loop to all tier reviewers (S5); caching (S4); integration tests against live providers (S7) ## Done Definitions - When complete, a fixture review hitting the soft cap receives the wrap-up nudge and emits final findings on the next turn ← Satisfies: SC4 (nudge -> JSON path) - When complete, a fixture review continuing to emit context-requests past soft_cap+3 records as failed via record-review.sh and no findings are produced ← Satisfies: SC4 (fail-closed recording) - When complete, a post-nudge assistant turn containing both a well-formed request and final findings has the request ignored AND counts as a strike toward the second nudge ← Satisfies: SC4 (post-nudge state-machine rule) - When complete, unit tests written and passing for each branch of the cascade including per-tier soft-cap override and the post-nudge mixed-turn rule ← Satisfies: SC6 (state machine tests) ## Considerations - [Reliability] Soft-cap × deep-tier 4-agent multiplier can self-induce 429s on shared API keys; per-tier override allows tightening defaults for deep specialists separately - [Maintainability] Document the multiplier interaction in CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md when adding the config keys ## Escalation Policy **Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
